## 3. The evidence that moved it



**The templated preclinical block hits 33, its highest strict count in the
corpus.** Thirteen in *J Immunother Cancer*, six in *Cancer Cell*, five in
*Nature Cancer*. This is the month to hold in mind whenever a later briefing
claims the genre is declining: it is not the start of a decline, it is the peak
of a series that turns out to have no trend at all once every month is counted
by the same rule.

**Neoantigen vaccines split inside one journal issue.**
[39972124](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39972124/) reports that RNA neoantigen
vaccines prime long-lived CD8 T cells in pancreatic cancer;
[39972134](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39972134/) reports that clonal driver
neoantigens are lost under TKI and immune selection pressure. Same journal, same
date. The thread has been `splitting` from the month it opened, and the split is
not between labs — it is between the clinical arm and the target-space arm.

**Low-dose gut irradiation improves PD-L1 blockade in patients**
([40068595](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40068595/), *Cancer Cell*). Worth
flagging because it is one of very few microbiome-adjacent interventions in the
corpus with a human readout rather than a mouse one, in a thread whose weakness
is precisely that its microbial arm never reaches patients.

## 4. Refutations

### (a) Landing on a tracked thread

[40023157](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40023157/) (*Immunity*): IL-17RA
signalling provides a dual tumour-*suppressor* function in late-stage colorectal
carcinogenesis. IL-17 is targeted therapeutically on the assumption that it is
inflammatory and pro-tumour.

[39551185](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39551185/) (*Ann Oncol*): tumour and
blood B-cell abundance **outperforms** established checkpoint-response prediction
signatures in head and neck cancer. A simple cell-count beating the signature
layer is the same shape as the computational refutations that arrive in 2026,
arriving here from the wet side.

### (b) Method credibility

Eight cards, and unusually they cluster on single-cell rather than on genomics.
[40069819](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40069819/): single-cell RNA-seq data
carry prevalent blood contamination. [40098192](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40098192/):
single-cell differential expression has shortcomings requiring a new statistical
paradigm. [40234247](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40234247/): single-cell
classifiers are vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Three independent statements,
in one month, that the most-used analysis stack in the corpus is unreliable at
different layers — contamination in the input, miscalibration in the test,
brittleness in the classifier.

[39965933](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39965933/): the transcriptomic and
proteomic effects of gene deletion are not evolutionarily conserved. Every
cross-species inference from a knockout inherits this.

[40119729](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40119729/): spuriously transcribed RNAs
from CRISPR-sgRNA expression plasmids scaffold condensates and hamper accurate
genomic imaging — an artifact created by the tool, visible only to people looking
for it.

[39891002](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39891002/) (*Nat Med*): familial
confounding underlies the reported associations between maternal health and
autism.

[40164443](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40164443/): retraction and replacement
of a histone methyltransferase paper — the rarer and more honourable form of
correction, where the replacement runs in the same issue.
